additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support Team in regards of ticket
ID0450170.
Could you please clarify what do you mean with "reduce the power limitation for DC1 and DC2"? Currently the outlets are limited to 200kW from SCB.
The brightness of the HMI is set via OCPP Backend. According to OCPP 1.6 standard (Chapter 9.1.9), the parameter is "LighIntensity", and the brightness percentage can be modified and it will be set to the charger.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: AW: AW: ID0450170-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP/S0 170004175] Reduce power limitation CRM:02889000642
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
The charging session on DC1 is over and onsite they unplugged the EV, so I was able to change the power limitation. Power limitation from SCB is now 400kW:
For what concerns the adjustment of the LEDs brightness, I have to correct my previous statements. I read some internal documentation in the meanwhile, and found out that such type of change (i.e. a change of a parameter in the configuration file when no OCPP Backend is connected) is not possible on v7.0.5.
On FW versions <=v7.0.5, a change of the configuration file is possible, but everytime the sicharge-cp-backend is restarted (for example with a reboot), the default value is overwritten, in case a OCPP Backend is not setting it back to a different value.
For v8.0.5 instead, this topic was discussed for other parameters, and v8.0.5 should allow to change a parameter of the config file and not have it overwritten after a reboot if no Backend is configured. This behavior has not been tested for the "LightIntensity" parameter itself, but there should not be any problem.
In conclusion, in order to adjust the LEDs brightness, I need first to update the charger to v8.0.5, and then perform the change in the Charger Configuration file.
The charger is currently running with FW
v7.0.5-0-gd66ba3a+E1412+FileH
, both Hotfixes are included in v8.0.5.
Kindly waiting for your confirmation to proceed with the FW update, so to perform the LEDs brightness adjustment.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
